Thanks for the use case. This is an automated hermes-sweeper review.

The requested per-agent/per-delegation temperature control matches the linked duplicate #31516, where the maintainer explicitly declined the same `delegate_task` temperature direction. This falls under the standing policy against per-call/per-task delegation routing controls; subagents use the parent configuration, with only the installation-wide `delegation.provider` / `delegation.model` configuration sanctioned.

- #31516 contains the directly matching proposal and maintainer decision: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues/31516#issuecomment-4885451706
- Current `delegate_task` documentation preserves the non-per-call child model contract in `tools/delegate_tool.py:3263`.
- For supported heterogeneous Mixture-of-Agents roles, MoA presets provide `reference_temperature` and `aggregator_temperature`; see `hermes_cli/moa_config.py:129` and `website/docs/user-guide/features/mixture-of-agents.md:88`.

Closing as not planned rather than as a defect in the current delegation implementation.

---
*Closed as not-planned per standing maintainer policy (`delegation-model-routing`). This is a design-direction decision, not a code-quality judgment — see the Contribution Rubric in `AGENTS.md` for what the project is looking for. If you believe this policy was misapplied to your change, comment here and a maintainer will take a look.*
